scene: Winning the match, you step outside to transit lines.
picture: A flat side view along a lively canal-side transit dock. An elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap and orange cardigan stands holding his wooden cane, left of centre. On the far left waits a brass mechanical rickshaw. Centre sits an idling yellow monorail car. On the far right waits a glass funicular carriage.
shown: a mechanical rickshaw with glowing wheels parked on the far left
a sleek yellow monorail car sitting at a platform in the centre
a glass-walled funicular railway carriage resting on rails on the far right
